actual_production.table_meaning: Actual completed factory floor manufacturing yields and batch outputs.
table_behavioral_rules: Color Foreign Key: In actual_production table, `actual_production.product_color_id` links directly to `product_color.id` (table `product_color`, column `product_color.color`). ALWAYS join `product_color pc ON actual_production.product_color_id = pc.id` (NEVER join `color` table).
Actual Output Metric: `apq` represents Actual Production Quantity. Always use `SUM(apq)` to compute total manufactured yield.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: In actual_production table, `product_color_id` joins to `product_color.id` (table `product_color`), NOT `color.id`.
Join `production` on `actual_production.production_id = production.id` to access planned targets and machine assignments.

product_type_id.business_meaning: Product Type Id attribute of actual_production.

product_color_id.business_meaning: Product Color Id attribute linking to product_color.id.
behavioral_rules: Foreign key to `product_color.id`. Join `product_color pc ON actual_production.product_color_id = pc.id` to retrieve `pc.color`.
join_warnings: Do NOT join to the `color` table; join `product_color` on `product_color_id = product_color.id`.

apq.business_meaning: Actual Production Quantity achieved on factory floor.
behavioral_rules: Actual floor output metric (APQ); only use when the question explicitly asks for 'actual production quantity' or 'APQ'.
Do NOT use `actual_production.apq` as the default production quantity for a batch or product; use `production.qty` instead because many batches do not have recorded actual_production rows.
join_warnings: For general production quantity or batch quantity queries, use `production.qty` from the `production` table. Do NOT rely solely on `actual_production.apq`.

delivery_challan.table_meaning: Outbound shipment dispatch notes and logistics manifests.
table_behavioral_rules: Delivery Challan (DC) vs Invoice: A Delivery Challan is a separate shipping/dispatch document, distinct from invoices. The DC number is stored in `dc_no` and the DC date is in `dc_date`.

Financial Year Reset: `dc_no` is NOT globally unique; it repeats across different financial years (e.g. DC 527 exists in 2022-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 for different customers). When queried for a specific DC number without a financial year specified, ALWAYS order by `dc_date DESC LIMIT 1` to target the latest record, and join `financial_year fy ON delivery_challan.financial_id = fy.id` to include `fy.fyear`.

Due Date Linkage: Delivery challan has NO due_date column. The due date of the underlying order is stored in `sales_order.so_due_date`. When queried for the due date of a delivery challan (DC), ALWAYS join `sales_order so ON delivery_challan.sales_order_id = so.id` and select `so.so_due_date AS due_date`.

Direct Party Link: `delivery_challan.party_id` connects DIRECTLY to `party.id`. For queries asking for delivery challans or DC numbers for a customer/party, join `party p ON delivery_challan.party_id = p.id`.
Logistics Details: Carrier is `transport_name`, driver is `driver_name`, vehicle is `vehicle_no`.
Sales Order Linkage: Links to `sales_order` via `sales_order_id`.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: Do NOT use `transporter_name` or `so_id`; use `transport_name` and `sales_order_id`.

dc_no.business_meaning: Delivery Challan (DC) number. Repeats across different financial years.
behavioral_rules: Use `delivery_challan.dc_no` for all Delivery Challan (DC) number queries.

Document numbers repeat in different financial years! When querying a specific `dc_no` without a year specified, order by `dc_date DESC LIMIT 1` to return the latest record, and join `financial_year fy ON delivery_challan.financial_id = fy.id` to include `fy.fyear`.
Never search for DC numbers in `stock.invoice_no`.
join_warnings: Join `party p ON delivery_challan.party_id = p.id` to get customer/party details.
Always join `financial_year fy ON delivery_challan.financial_id = fy.id` when disambiguating multi-year delivery challans.

behavioral_rules: Use `delivery_challan.dc_date` for delivery challan dates.

join_warnings: Delivery challan has no due date column; due dates must be fetched from `sales_order.so_due_date` via this join.

lead.table_meaning: CRM prospective client inquiries, sales leads, and deal pipeline tracking.
table_behavioral_rules: Enum Translation: `status` allowed values are 'Pending', 'In-Progress', 'Success', 'Reject'.

Lead Name Search: A lead can be referenced by person contact name (`lead.contact_name`) or company (`lead.company_name`). When filtering by a lead or client name in WHERE clause, check `(lead.contact_name LIKE '%<name>%' OR lead.company_name LIKE '%<name>%')`.
Sales Rep Allocation: Assigned sales representative is stored in `lead_assign_to`, which foreign-keys to `users.id` (`users.name`).
Follow-up Medium Typo: Column is named `followup_medimum` (with an extra 'm'). Allowed values: 'Email', 'Call', 'PersonalMeeting', 'WhatsappMessage'.

Open Leads Follow-up Rule: For open leads waiting for follow-up, do NOT restrict to >= CURDATE() unless 'future' or 'upcoming' is explicitly requested; filter by `status IN ('Pending', 'In-Progress') AND next_followup_date IS NOT NULL`.
Follow-up Inquiries by Year: When asked for follow-ups in a specific year (e.g. 2023), filter on `YEAR(lead.next_followup_date) = YYYY`.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: To get the sales rep name, join `users ON lead.lead_assign_to = users.id` (do not join `party`).
Do NOT join to the `cities` table; query `lead.city` directly as a text string.

packagings.table_meaning: Packagings operational records in Packaging & Stock.
table_behavioral_rules: Carton Count vs Carton Quantity: Each row in `packagings` represents ONE physical carton box. `COUNT(pk.id)` or `COUNT(*)` returns the number of physical boxes (e.g. 412 cartons). `pk.qty` stores the product quantity inside that carton box. Therefore, `SUM(pk.qty)` returns the TOTAL CARTON QUANTITY (e.g. 152,354 units). When asked for 'carton quantity', 'total carton quantity', or 'quantity stored in warehouse', ALWAYS use `SUM(pk.qty)`, NEVER `COUNT(*)`!

Warehouse Matching: Warehouse codes (e.g. 'pm2bzd19') belong to `warehouse.warehouse_code` and warehouse names (e.g. '110') belong to `warehouse.location_name`. ALWAYS join `warehouse w ON packagings.warehouse_id = w.id` and filter `w.warehouse_code = '<code_or_name>'` or `w.location_name = '<name>'`. Do NOT filter `packagings.location_code` for warehouse codes; `location_code` only stores internal bin/rack shelf identifiers.
MUST append `packagings.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).

To find Customers: Disambiguate by joining to `sales_order` (`party.id = sales_order.party_id`).
To find Suppliers/Vendors: Disambiguate by joining to `purchase` (`party.id = purchase.party_id`).
Active Status Enum: `status = 'Y'` means Active, `status = 'N'` means Inactive.
Customer/Supplier Name: Always select `party.party_name` (do NOT use `name` or `customer_name`).
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: Do NOT join to the `cities` table; the `cities` table is empty (0 rows). Query `party.city` directly as a text string.

Product Color & Stock: When queried for a product's stock and color, query `product p JOIN product_color pc ON pc.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.product_color_id = pc.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%<sku>%' GROUP BY p.product_name, pc.color`.
Unit Price: Stored in `rate`.
Minimum Stock Threshold: Stored in `minimum_stock`.
Finished Goods Enum: `product_type_id = 2` designates Finished Goods.

production.table_meaning: Factory production planning orders specifying target quantities for machines and products.
table_behavioral_rules: Color Foreign Key: In production table, `production.product_color_id` links directly to `product_color.id` (table `product_color`, column `product_color.color`). ALWAYS join `product_color pc ON production.product_color_id = pc.id` (NEVER join `color` table).

Production Quantity: `production.qty` is the primary production and batch quantity. For general queries asking for production quantity, batch quantity, or quantity produced for a batch or product, use `production.qty`. Do NOT use `actual_production.apq` unless the user explicitly asks for APQ / actual floor output vs target.

Target vs Actual: If explicitly comparing planned vs actual, `production.qty` represents the batch target quantity, and `actual_production.apq` represents recorded APQ output. Never use `actual_production.apq` alone for general production quantity questions as many batches only have quantity in `production.qty`.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: In production table, `product_color_id` joins to `product_color.id` (table `product_color`), NOT `color.id`.
To find production shortfalls or actual outputs, LEFT JOIN `actual_production` on `production.id = actual_production.production_id`.

product_type_id.business_meaning: Product Type Id attribute of production.

product_color_id.business_meaning: Product Color Id attribute linking to product_color.id.
behavioral_rules: Foreign key linking to `product_color.id`. Join `product_color pc ON production.product_color_id = pc.id` to access `pc.color`.
join_warnings: Do NOT join to `color.id`; join `product_color` on `product_color_id = product_color.id`.

auto_batch_no.business_meaning: Auto Batch No attribute of production.

qty.business_meaning: Primary production quantity of the batch (also serves as production target).
behavioral_rules: Primary quantity field for production batches. For questions asking for production quantity or batch quantity, select `production.qty AS production_quantity` (or `SUM(production.qty)`).
Do NOT use actual_production.apq for general production quantity queries, as actual_production is unpopulated or 0 for many batches.

machine_id.business_meaning: Foreign key linking production to machine.id.
behavioral_rules: Foreign key linking to `machine.id`.
Join `machine m ON production.machine_id = m.id` to access `m.machine_name`.
To find which machine made a product (e.g. CAP03), join `production prd JOIN product p ON prd.product_id = p.id JOIN machine m ON prd.machine_id = m.id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%<product>%'`.
join_warnings: Do NOT search for product names inside production.batch_no; always join product table.

sales_order.table_meaning: Customer sales order headers recording order dates, customer references, and financial year links.
table_behavioral_rules: NON-EXISTENT COLUMN: `sales_order` has NO total amount column. You MUST calculate order totals by joining `sales_order_products` and `product` via SUM(sop.qty * p.rate).

Financial Year Reset: `sales_order_no` is NOT globally unique; it repeats across different financial years (e.g. Sales Order 405 exists in 2022-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 for different customers). When queried for a specific order number without a year specified, ALWAYS order by `sales_order_date DESC LIMIT 1` to target the latest record, and join `financial_year fy ON sales_order.financial_id = fy.id` to include `fy.fyear`.
Customer Linkage: `party_id` links to `party.id`. Always join `party` to get `party.party_name`.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).

ONLY when explicitly querying the current financial year ('current', 'this year', 'active'), join `financial_year` and filter `financial_year.current_year = 'Y'`. For all-time, cumulative, or unconstrained queries, DO NOT filter by current_year.
join_warnings: Do NOT attempt to SELECT total_amount, grand_total, or status from `sales_order` (they do not exist on this table).

sales_order_no.business_meaning: Sales Order Number. Repeats across different financial years.
behavioral_rules: Document numbers repeat in different financial years! When querying a specific `sales_order_no` without a year specified, order by `sales_order_date DESC LIMIT 1` to return the latest record, and join `financial_year fy ON sales_order.financial_id = fy.id` to include `fy.fyear`.
join_warnings: Always join `financial_year fy ON sales_order.financial_id = fy.id` when disambiguating multi-year orders.

sales_order_date.business_meaning: Sales Order Date attribute of sales_order.

so_due_date.business_meaning: Sales order delivery due date / commitment date.
behavioral_rules: Authoritative column for order and delivery due dates.
For Delivery Challan due dates, join `sales_order so ON delivery_challan.sales_order_id = so.id` and select `so.so_due_date AS due_date`.

party_po_no.business_meaning: Customer's / Party's Purchase Order number placed on us.
behavioral_rules: When user asks for 'party PO number', 'customer PO', or 'PO number' for an order, query `sales_order.party_po_no` (join `party p ON sales_order.party_id = p.id`).
join_warnings: Do NOT use purchase.ref_po_no for customer PO requests; purchase.ref_po_no is for inward supplier purchases.

party_po_date.business_meaning: Party Po Date attribute of sales_order.

sales_order_products.table_meaning: Line-item product details for each sales order.

Line Value Calculation: Calculate line total as `sop.qty * p.rate` by joining `product p ON sop.product_id = p.id`.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: Always join `product` to retrieve item name and unit price (`product.rate`).

sales_order_id.business_meaning: Sales Order Id attribute of sales_order_products.

behavioral_rules: MUST use CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(10,2)) or numeric arithmetic before aggregation.
Calculate sales order revenue as SUM(sop.qty * p.rate).

stock.table_meaning: Physical on-hand inventory balances by product, color, and warehouse location.
table_behavioral_rules: Color Foreign Key: In stock table, `stock.product_color_id` links directly to `product_color.id` (table `product_color`, column `product_color.color`). ALWAYS join `product_color pc ON s.product_color_id = pc.id` (do NOT join `color`).
Batch No vs Product Name: `stock.batch_no` contains numeric lot numbers (e.g. '739', '820'). Product SKU codes (e.g. 'CHP14065105-OUTER') are in `product.product_name`.
SPARSE TABLE WARNING: This table is SPARSE. It only contains rows for items with >0 quantity. Absence of a row means zero stock.
To find zero-stock or low-stock items, or all colors of a product, you MUST start from `product p LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_color pc ON s.product_color_id = pc.id`.
MUST append `alias.deleted_at IS NULL` to exclude soft-deleted inventory for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: In stock table, `product_color_id` joins to `product_color.id` (table `product_color`), NOT `color.id`.
Never use an INNER JOIN on `stock` when querying for low stock or out-of-stock items; an INNER JOIN eliminates 0-stock products.

invoice_no.business_meaning: Actual Invoice Number for purchase inward / invoice stock movements.
behavioral_rules: For invoice queries (e.g. invoice list, invoice count), query `stock` where `stock_type = 'PI'`.
Calculate invoice count as `COUNT(DISTINCT stock.invoice_no)`.
join_warnings: Do NOT use the proforma table for invoice queries unless the user specifically asks for proforma.
Do NOT use `stock.invoice_no` for DC numbers. Delivery Challan numbers are stored in `delivery_challan.dc_no`.

behavioral_rules: When `stock_type = 'PI'`, `stock.party_id` connects DIRECTLY to `party.id`. Join `party p ON stock.party_id = p.id`.
join_warnings: For `stock_type = 'PI'`, join party directly via `stock.party_id = party.id`. Do NOT route through sales_order.

product_type_id.business_meaning: Product Type Id attribute of stock.

product_color_id.business_meaning: Product Color Id attribute of stock linking to product_color.id.
behavioral_rules: Foreign key to `product_color.id`. Join `product_color pc ON stock.product_color_id = pc.id` to retrieve `pc.color`.
join_warnings: Do NOT join to the `color` table; join `product_color` on `stock.product_color_id = product_color.id`.

product_batch_id.business_meaning: Product Batch Id attribute of stock.

carton_product_id.business_meaning: Carton Product Id attribute of stock.

carton_verify_status.business_meaning: Warehouse physical audit and verification state of carton box.
behavioral_rules: Enum Translation: 'P' means Pending / Unverified Carton.
Enum Translation: 'V' means Verified Carton.

carton_verify_at.business_meaning: Carton Verify At attribute of stock.

qty.business_meaning: Quantity of product units in stock.
behavioral_rules: MUST use CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(10,2)) before ANY aggregation (SUM, AVG) or mathematical comparison.
Stock rows represent positive balances; use COALESCE(SUM(CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) when LEFT JOINing.
join_warnings: Stored as VARCHAR(50) in MySQL; never aggregate directly without CAST.

status.business_meaning: Physical disposition status of inventory row.
behavioral_rules: Enum Translation: 'B' means Booked / Available On-Hand Stock.
Enum Translation: 'D' means Dispatched / Shipped Stock.
For available warehouse inventory, MUST filter `stock.status = 'B'`.

stock_adjustment.table_meaning: Primary table for inventory stock adjustments, stock-in additions, and stock-out write-offs.
table_behavioral_rules: Authoritative Table: `stock_adjustment` is the primary table for ALL manual stock adjustments (stock-in, stock-out, physical count corrections, scrap/wastage). NEVER query `stock` for stock adjustments (`stock` is for purchase inward and sales dispatches). NEVER query `product_packaging_detail` for stock adjustments (`product_packaging_detail` is a packaging BOM master table).

Transaction Type Enum: `stock_adjustment.transaction_type` has ONLY two valid values: `'StockOut'` (stock reduction / outward adjustment) and `'StockIn'` (stock addition / inward adjustment). NEVER use `'OUT'`, `'IN'`, `'Stock-Out'`, `'Stock_Out'`, or lowercase strings. For stock-out queries, filter `sa.transaction_type = 'StockOut'`. For stock-in queries, filter `sa.transaction_type = 'StockIn'`.
Adjustment Date: `stock_adjustment.stock_adjustment_date` is the transaction date (e.g. `'2025-06-03'`).

Direct Category & Product Links: Connects directly to `category` via `category_id = category.id`, `product` via `product_id = product.id`, `product_color` via `product_color_id = product_color.id`, and `financial_year` via `financial_id = financial_year.id`.
MUST append `stock_adjustment.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
join_warnings: Do NOT join `stock` or `product_packaging_detail` for stock adjustment queries; use `stock_adjustment` directly.

behavioral_rules: Exact enum values: 'StockOut' and 'StockIn'. NEVER use 'OUT' or 'IN'.
Filter by date using `stock_adjustment.stock_adjustment_date = 'YYYY-MM-DD'`.

product_type_id.business_meaning: Product Type Id attribute of stock_adjustment.

category_id.business_meaning: Foreign key to category.id. Links adjustment to category (e.g. 'Carton', 'Raw Material').
behavioral_rules: Join `category c ON stock_adjustment.category_id = c.id` to filter by category name.

product_id.business_meaning: Foreign key to product.id. Links adjustment to product name.
behavioral_rules: Join `product p ON stock_adjustment.product_id = p.id` to filter by product name.
Join `product_color pc ON stock_adjustment.product_color_id = pc.id`.
Authoritative column for stock adjustment quantities. Use `SUM(stock_adjustment.qty)` for total adjusted quantity.

unit.table_meaning: Unit operational records in Master Data.
table_behavioral_rules: MUST append `unit.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).
The unit table contains master units of measurement ('Pcs', 'Kg', 'Nos', 'Set', etc.), NOT product names.
To find the unit for a product, query `product p JOIN unit u ON p.unit_id = u.id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%<product>%'`.
join_warnings: Never filter unit.unit_name by product names (e.g. CAP03); always join through product.unit_id.

table_behavioral_rules: Staff Name: Stored in `name`.

email_verified_at.business_meaning: Email Verified At attribute of users.

table_behavioral_rules: Warehouse Identification: Warehouses are identified by `warehouse.warehouse_code` (e.g. 'pm2bzd19') and `warehouse.location_name` (e.g. '110'). When a query specifies a warehouse code or name, ALWAYS match against `warehouse.warehouse_code` or `warehouse.location_name` (e.g. `WHERE (w.warehouse_code = 'pm2bzd19' OR w.location_name = '110')`). NEVER search for warehouse codes in `packagings.location_code`.
Link to Packagings: Connects to inventory cartons via `packagings.warehouse_id = warehouse.id`.

Carton Count vs Carton Quantity: In `packagings`, each row is one carton box. To calculate TOTAL CARTON QUANTITY (total product units inside cartons in a warehouse), use `SUM(pk.qty)` (e.g. 152,354 units). To calculate TOTAL CARTONS (number of physical boxes), use `COUNT(pk.id)` (e.g. 412 cartons). When asked for 'carton quantity' or 'quantity in warehouse', ALWAYS use `SUM(pk.qty)`, NOT `COUNT(*)`!
MUST append `warehouse.deleted_at IS NULL` in WHERE clause for standard operational queries (omit or invert if querying deleted/archived records).

location_name.business_meaning: Warehouse facility name or location number (e.g. '110', 'Main Warehouse').
behavioral_rules: Use for matching warehouse names or location numbers.
Use `warehouse.warehouse_code` for matching warehouse codes.
